query: How can I apply for or renew APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC)?
reference_answer: All APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC) applications must be submitted online at the e-Service. The card will be mailed by registered post to the applicant when it is ready.
answer: To apply for or renew an APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC), visit the APEC website and follow the steps outlined there. [Document 1]
